name: Shredding Scales
body:
School evocation; Level arcanist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, bloodrager 2, magus 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal (must have scales)
Effect all creatures in a 30 ft. burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Note: This spell was designed to be used by dragons, thus it may alter or replace core dragon abilities (like frightful presence etc.)

Scales spring from your hide, each spinning at great speed, twisting and turning in chaotic fashion. All creatures that are caught in the 30-foot burst take 4d4 slashing damage.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
